notes: Rights-holder edge, distinct from the existing rel-driscolls-develops-drisblueseventeen (breeder edge) -- Driscoll's is both breeder and rights holder here, but the two roles are separately real and separately evidenced by the same PBR grant (Canada PBR certificate 7097, granted 2024-05-03, applicant Driscoll's, Inc.).
